items.title: Ed Allen Interview, 1961-01-14
items.q: I told him, I don't remember, Sam Wilson told him to make some money

ctx.x: And we hadn't played it before?

No, he hadn't played it before. No, he hadn't played it before. I was actually here to him playing. I told him, I don't remember, Sam Wilson told him to make some money, he was featuring the Washboard then. So that's when he first started. It seemed like he'd be very good. Then Clarence, some of the records, Clarence's brother played the Washboard. He had a brother who just played the Washboard on Saturday. He wasn't the drummer, just the Washboard band? No, just Washboard band. But see on the Washboard, they…
Did they ever use Washboards on a regular job in the evening? You mean on a steady job? Not as I knew of. I couldn't say yes or no.
